name: ImbalancedChen.p5U7OmegaArgument_abs_sub_le
source_header:
theorem p5U7OmegaArgument_abs_sub_le {t u v w : ℝ}
    (h : p5U7OmegaClosedSupport t u) (h' : p5U7OmegaClosedSupport v w) :
    |p5U7OmegaArgument t u - p5U7OmegaArgument v w| ≤
      5 * |t - v| + 25 * |u - w|

name: ImbalancedChen.p5U7OmegaKernel_abs_sub_le_original
source_header:
theorem p5U7OmegaKernel_abs_sub_le_original {t u v w : ℝ}
    (h : p5U7OmegaClosedSupport t u) (h' : p5U7OmegaClosedSupport v w) :
    |p5U7OmegaKernel 1 t u - p5U7OmegaKernel 1 v w| ≤
      5000 * (|t - v| + |u - w|)

name: ImbalancedChen.p5U7_logLower_nonneg
source_header:
theorem p5U7_logLower_nonneg (n : ℕ) (q : ℚ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) :
    0 ≤ logLower n q

name: ImbalancedChen.p5U7_buchstab_first_rational_interval
source_header:
theorem p5U7_buchstab_first_rational_interval
    (L U : ℚ) (hL : 1 ≤ L) (hU : U ≤ 2)
    {s : ℝ} (hsL : (L : ℝ) ≤ s) (hsU : s ≤ (U : ℝ)) :
    ((1 / U : ℚ) : ℝ) ≤ buchstab s ∧
      buchstab s ≤ ((1 / L : ℚ) : ℝ)

name: ImbalancedChen.p5U7_buchstab_second_rational_interval
source_header:
theorem p5U7_buchstab_second_rational_interval
    (n : ℕ) (L U : ℚ) (hL : 2 ≤ L) (hU : U ≤ 132 / 59)
    {s : ℝ} (hsL : (L : ℝ) ≤ s) (hsU : s ≤ (U : ℝ)) :
    (((1 + logLower n L) / U : ℚ) : ℝ) ≤ buchstab s ∧
      buchstab s ≤ (((1 + logUpper n U) / L : ℚ) : ℝ)

name: ImbalancedChen.p5U7_argument_rational_box
source_header:
theorem p5U7_argument_rational_box
    (a b c d L U : ℚ) (hc : 0 < c) (hL : 1 ≤ L) (hLU : L ≤ U)
    (hleft : b + (1 + L) * d ≤ 1) (hright : 1 ≤ a + (1 + U) * c)
    {t u : ℝ} (ht : (a : ℝ) ≤ t ∧ t ≤ (b : ℝ))
    (hu : (c : ℝ) ≤ u ∧ u ≤ (d : ℝ)) :
    (L : ℝ) ≤ p5U7OmegaArgument t u ∧
      p5U7OmegaArgument t u ≤ (U : ℝ)

name: ImbalancedChen.p5U7_original_first_rational_cell_bounds
source_header:
theorem p5U7_original_first_rational_cell_bounds
    (a b c d L U : ℚ) (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hL : 1 ≤ L) (hLU : L ≤ U) (hU : U ≤ 2)
    (hleft : b + (1 + L) * d ≤ 1) (hright : 1 ≤ a + (1 + U) * c)
    {t u : ℝ} (ht : (a : ℝ) ≤ t ∧ t ≤ (b : ℝ))
    (hu : (c : ℝ) ≤ u ∧ u ≤ (d : ℝ)) :
    (p5U7FirstCellLower b d U : ℝ) ≤ p5U7OmegaKernel 1 t u ∧
      p5U7OmegaKernel 1 t u ≤ (p5U7FirstCellUpper a c L : ℝ)

name: ImbalancedChen.p5U7_original_second_rational_cell_bounds
source_header:
theorem p5U7_original_second_rational_cell_bounds
    (n : ℕ) (a b c d L U : ℚ) (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hL : 2 ≤ L) (hLU : L ≤ U) (hU : U ≤ 132 / 59)
    (hleft : b + (1 + L) * d ≤ 1) (hright : 1 ≤ a + (1 + U) * c)
    {t u : ℝ} (ht : (a : ℝ) ≤ t ∧ t ≤ (b : ℝ))
    (hu : (c : ℝ) ≤ u ∧ u ≤ (d : ℝ)) :
    (p5U7SecondCellLower n b d L U : ℝ) ≤ p5U7OmegaKernel 1 t u ∧
      p5U7OmegaKernel 1 t u ≤ (p5U7SecondCellUpper n a c L U : ℝ)
